children: Gravitas Collective Discloses 19.9% Stake in Hepion Pharmaceuticals

Gravitas Collective Corp. reported a 19.9% stake in Hepion Pharmaceuticals, Inc., receiving 25 million shares in exchange for its membership interests in Gravitas Life Sciences, Inc. The exchange took place on October 6, 2026. The transaction makes Gravitas Collective a significant Hepion shareholder, though it disclosed no specific plans beyond holding the shares as an investment.
Gravitas Collective says it holds the Hepion shares for investment purposes and may acquire more shares from time to time. It reports no other current plans or proposals related to Hepion.

Gravitas Collective Corp. is a New Jersey corporation with a business address in Verona, New Jersey. It solely owned the membership interests in Gravitas Life Sciences, Inc. that it exchanged for Hepion shares. The filing does not provide further details about Gravitas Collective’s operations or investment history.
